source_type: Official Volkswagen UK general warning-light pages
scope_limitation: These pages establish the general symbol meaning shown by Volkswagen UK. They do not identify a model, generation, manual edition, powertrain or equipment package and therefore do not replace the model-selected Golf 11/2020, Golf VII 11/2019 and ID.4 11/2021 manuals.

pages.page_title: Yellow Headlight Range Control Warning Light | Volkswagen UK
pages.statement: There is a fault in the headlight range control system. Please contact an authorised repairer.
pages.state: illuminated; no flashing variant stated on this page

source_image.alt: Amber headlight range control warning light
source_image.republication: not included; used only for visual source comparison

pages.catalogue_result: The existing vw-range record is retained as a general Volkswagen UK assignment and explicitly distinguished from a generic lighting/bulb fault. Model applicability remains pending until an exact model manual documents this symbol.

pages.page_title: Lane Assist Warning Light | Yellow | Volkswagen UK
statements: The amber indicator comes on when Lane Assist is switched on and road markings cannot be detected.
Only when the indicator is accompanied by the message ‘system fault’ does this page instruct the driver to contact a retailer.
pages.state: system enabled but road markings not detected; fault only with the stated accompanying message

source_image.republication: not included; used only for visual source comparison

pages.catalogue_result: The page is recorded as evidence that amber alone is not a fault. It is not assigned to a specific model. The page’s lane-lines-only source graphic differs from the current licensed car-between-lanes depiction, so no approximate customer card is published from this general page.
